examples.en: The river has a broad and calm surface.
examples.ko: 그 강은 넓고 잔잔한 수면을 가지고 있다.

examples.en: He has broad shoulders and strong arms.
examples.ko: 그는 넓은 어깨와 강한 팔을 가지고 있다.

examples.en: The news broadcast starts at nine tonight.
examples.ko: 뉴스 방송은 오늘 밤 아홉 시에 시작한다.

examples.en: They broadcast the game live across the country.
examples.ko: 그들은 전국에 그 경기를 생방송으로 방송했다.

examples.en: I have three sisters and one brother.
examples.ko: 나는 자매가 세 명, 남동생이 한 명 있다.

examples.en: My brother plays soccer very well.
Mary has long brown hair.
examples.ko: 메리는 길고 갈색인 머리카락을 가지고 있다.

examples.en: I bought brown shoes yesterday.
Brush your teeth every day.
She used a soft brush.
He used brute force to open the door.
The brute knocked down the fence easily.
examples.ko: 그 난폭한 남자는 울타리를 쉽게 넘어뜨렸다.

examples.en: Soap bubbles floated in the air.
The children blew bubbles in the park.
We need to plan our budget carefully.
The company cut its budget this year.
There is a bug on the leaf.
The program has a small bug.
They build houses every year.
We are building a new school.
We buy rice in bulk to save money.
examples.ko: 우리는 돈을 아끼려고 쌀을 대량으로 산다.

examples.en: The bulk of the work is finished now.
The bull ran across the field.
A bull has two sharp horns.
examples.ko: 황소는 날카로운 뿔이 두 개 있다.

examples.en: Don't be a bully to others.
examples.ko: 다른 사람을 괴롭히는 사람이 되지 마.

examples.en: He was bullied by older students.
examples.ko: 그는 나이 많은 학생들에게 괴롭힘을 당했다.

examples.en: I bumped into an old friend today.
examples.ko: 나는 오늘 옛 친구와 우연히 마주쳤다.

examples.en: Watch out, don't bump your head.
She bought a bunch of bananas.
A bunch of kids played outside.
He carried a bundle of sticks.
She wrapped the papers into a bundle.
Carrying that box is a heavy burden.
examples.ko: 그 상자를 나르는 것은 큰 부담이다.

examples.en: The debt became a huge burden for them.
examples.ko: 그 빚은 그들에게 큰 부담이 되었다.

examples.en: Paper burns very quickly.
She burned her hand today.
The balloon burst with a loud noise.
Tears burst from her eyes suddenly.
examples.ko: 그녀의 눈에서 갑자기 눈물이 터져 나왔다.

examples.en: Dogs often bury their bones.
They buried the treasure under the tree.
I go to school by bus.
The bus arrived late today.
A rabbit hid behind the bush.
They planted a rose bush in the yard.
My uncle owns a business.
She started her own business.
I am busy today.
Mom is busy in the kitchen.
It was cool, but windy.
I like tea, but not coffee.
examples.ko: 나는 차는 좋아하지만 커피는 좋아하지 않는다.

examples.en: The butcher cut fresh meat for us.
examples.ko: 정육점 주인이 우리를 위해 신선한 고기를 잘라 주었다.

examples.en: My father works as a butcher downtown.
examples.ko: 내 아버지는 시내에서 정육점 주인으로 일하신다.

examples.en: Spread butter on the bread.
She added butter to the pan.
Press the red button.
A button fell off my shirt.
Let's buy some milk.
I want to buy new shoes.
The bees buzzed around the flowers.
I heard a strange buzz from the phone.
examples.ko: 나는 전화기에서 이상한 윙윙 소리를 들었다.

examples.en: Sit by the window.
This book was written by her.
Connect the cable to the TV.
The cable car climbed up the mountain.
The bird lives in a cage.
They put the lion in a large cage.
She baked a chocolate cake.
We ate cake at the party.
Please calculate the total cost.
She calculated the answer quickly.
Look at the calendar on the wall.
I marked my birthday on the calendar.
Who’s calling, please?
I will call you tonight.
Calm down!
The lake was calm and quiet this morning.
I have a new camera.
He bought a small camera.
We went to summer camp.
They camped by the lake.
They joined a big campaign.
The campaign helped many poor people.
examples.ko: 그 캠페인은 많은 가난한 사람들을 도왔다.

examples.en: I (just) can’t believe this.
examples.ko: 나는 이 일이 도무지 믿기지 않는다.

examples.en: I can swim very well.
examples.ko: 나는 수영을 아주 잘할 수 있다.

examples.en: We had to cancel the trip.
She canceled her appointment yesterday.
Doctors are researching a cure for cancer.
Her grandmother survived breast cancer last year.
examples.ko: 그녀의 할머니는 작년에 유방암을 이겨 냈다.

examples.en: She is a candidate for class president.
Three candidates applied for the job.
examples.ko: 세 명의 지원자가 그 일자리에 지원했다.

examples.en: I love eating candy.
examples.ko: 나는 사탕 먹는 것을 정말 좋아한다.

examples.en: She gave me some candy.
The artist painted on a large canvas.
examples.ko: 그 화가는 큰 캔버스에 그림을 그렸다.

examples.en: He stretched the canvas before painting.
examples.ko: 그는 그림을 그리기 전에 캔버스를 팽팽하게 폈다.

examples.en: He wore a blue cap.
She lost her new cap.
She is capable of solving hard problems.
examples.ko: 그녀는 어려운 문제를 풀 수 있다.

examples.en: He is a very capable leader.
The hero wore a red cape.
Ships sailed around the cape carefully.
examples.ko: 배들이 그 곶을 조심스럽게 돌아 항해했다.
